name: Lucky Break: Dating in New York
source:
Lucky Break: Dating in New York is a modern slice-of-life dating simulator and visual novel developed by Socrates Games Studio. Set against the backdrop of modern New York City, the game features a highly realistic visual style driven by AI-powered full-motion video (FMV) sequences.  

Plot
The story follows a young man living in Queens who has had absolutely no luck navigating the modern dating app scene. Just as he is ready to throw in the towel, his phone unexpectedly lights up with three distinct matches in a single day. Each of these striking women offers a completely different perspective on life in the city, pulling the protagonist into a whirlwind of romance, personal connections, and choices that will shape his future.  

Characters
Ellie: A quiet, introspective barista who sketches the world around her in coffee stains and daydreams. Behind her shy, reserved exterior lies a deeply poetic heart and a creative spirit waiting for someone who truly appreciates her unique perspective.  

Alexandra: A highly analytical, sharp-minded professional working at a prestigious Manhattan investment bank. Thoroughly accustomed to a fast-paced world dominated by numbers and corporate masks, she keeps her guard up, but the right choices can break through her defenses.  

Katerina Delgado: A confident, independent 28-year-old Dominican–Puerto Rican manager working at the prestigious Plaza Hotel. Born and raised in Queens and now residing in Manhattan, Katerina is a passionate woman who knows exactly what she wants from life and refuses to settle for anything less.  

Features
Realistic Visual Presentation: Story scenes and romance interactions are depicted using realistic, AI-generated full-motion video sequences.  

Branching Choices: Multiple narrative paths and dating choices that determine which relationship the protagonist pursues.  

Mature Slice-of-Life: A grounded, mature-themed story exploring adult relationships with softcore romantic and sexual content.
translation:
《幸运突破：纽约约会》是一款由Socrates Games Studio开发的现代生活片段约会模拟器和视觉小说。该游戏以现代纽约市为背景，具有由人工智能驱动的全动态视频 (FMV) 序列驱动的高度逼真的视觉风格。

情节
这个故事讲述了一位住在皇后区的年轻人，他在现代约会应用程序领域完全没有运气。正当他准备认输时，他的手机意外亮起，一天内显示了三场不同的比赛。这些引人注目的女性中的每一位都对这座城市的生活提供了完全不同的视角，将主角带入浪漫、人际关系和塑造他未来的选择的旋风中。

人物
艾莉：一位安静、内省的咖啡师，用咖啡渍和白日梦勾勒出她周围的世界。在她害羞、矜持的外表背后，隐藏着一颗深深的诗意心灵和创作精神，等待着真正欣赏她独特视角的人。

亚历山德拉：一位分析能力强、头脑敏锐的专业人士，在曼哈顿一家著名的投资银行工作。她已经完全习惯了数字和企业面具主导的快节奏世界，因此保持警惕，但正确的选择可以突破她的防御。

Katerina Delgado：28岁，自信、独立的多米尼加裔波多黎各裔经理，在著名的广场酒店工作。卡特琳娜在皇后区出生和长大，现居住在曼哈顿，她是一位充满激情的女性，她清楚地知道自己想要从生活中得到什么，并且拒绝满足于其他任何事情。

特点
真实的视觉呈现：使用人工智能生成的真实全动态视频序列来描绘故事场景和浪漫互动。

分支选择：多种叙事路径和约会选择决定了主角追求哪种关系。

成熟的生活片段：一个脚踏实地、以成熟为主题的故事，通过色情浪漫和性内容探索成人关系。
